    said 4 files, then corrected itself to 3.
  - Agent 2 (read-only): It returned # wf-spike scratch, the first line of the
    README.
  - Agent 3 (worktree edit): EnterWorktree was refused inside the subagent, so
    it made the worktree by hand with git worktree add. The worktree is at
    .claude/worktrees/wf-spike on branch wf-spike. It appended "spike" to
    notes.txt and committed it there. The main checkout was untouched.

  The spike shows that a subagent can't call EnterWorktree, but it can still do
  isolated edits with git worktree add.

  The worktree and the wf-spike branch are still there. I can remove them if you
  want.
